# SplashLens

> Independent pool and spa field reference. Use the linked pages for current context; verify equipment-specific work against the exact manufacturer manual and qualified judgment. These files are discovery aids, not crawler permissions or training controls.

## Product and reference hubs

- [Home](https://splashlens.com/): product overview.
- [Pool service app](https://splashlens.com/pool-service-app.html): field-reference workflow, not a billing or route-management claim.
- [PartSnap pool parts identification](https://splashlens.com/partsnap-pool-part-identification-app.html): possible part matches, not confirmed fitment.
- [PartSnap proof library](https://splashlens.com/partsnap-proof-library.html): evidence to capture before ordering.
- [Pool equipment troubleshooting](https://splashlens.com/pool-equipment-troubleshooting.html): equipment-reference hub.
- [Closing Season Mode](https://splashlens.com/closing-season.html): closing documentation and proof workflow, not a winterization guarantee.
- [Spa and hot tub troubleshooting](https://splashlens.com/spa-hot-tub-troubleshooting-app.html): spa reference lane.
- [Source checklist index](https://splashlens.com/source-pages/): source-scoped checklists.
- [Verified Field Network](https://splashlens.com/verified-field-network.html): product direction; partner verification is conditional.
- [Jandy Insider connected-equipment radar](https://splashlens.com/source-pages/jandy-insider-connected-equipment-radar.html): independent evidence prompts, not official telemetry or service guidance.

## Source-scoped code answers

The four Hayward HeatPro code answers below cite a Hayward/Summit troubleshooting guide and require model/revision verification. Do not generalize their meanings to other equipment.

- [HeatPro LP](https://splashlens.com/error-codes/hayward/heatpro-heat-pump-lp-low-pressure-switch-tripped.html)
- [HeatPro HP](https://splashlens.com/error-codes/hayward/heatpro-heat-pump-hp-high-pressure-switch-tripped.html)
- [HeatPro HI](https://splashlens.com/error-codes/hayward/heatpro-heat-pump-hi-high-discharge-pressure.html)
- [HeatPro FLO](https://splashlens.com/error-codes/hayward/heatpro-heat-pump-flo-flow-error-no-water-flow.html)
